name: document_title
description: The main title of this document. The first prominent heading on the very first page, before any goal or target content begins.

name: source_url
description: A URL (http:// or https://) mentioned near the top of the document as the source the content was extracted from.

name: first_goal
description: The title of Goal 1 only. Appears on the first page in the format Goal 1. <title>. Extract only the title text after Goal 1., not the number.

name: no_of_targets
description: The total number of targets mentioned in the document, e.g. 169. Usually stated near the top as 169 Targets or similar.

name: total_goals_mentioned
description: The total number of SDGs stated explicitly in the document's introduction on page 1, e.g. 'the 17 Sustainable Development Goals'. Extract only the number as stated — do not count goals yourself.
